$$
\int (5x-50)^{1/2}\,\text{d}x.
$$

Now, we let $u=5x-50.$ Then differentiating with respect to $x$ gives

$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=5\,⟹\,\text{d}x=\frac{1}{5}\text{d}u.
$$

We now write our integral in terms of $u,$ calculate the integral as normal, and write the final answer in terms of $x$ at the very end:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int (5x-50)^{1/2}\,\text{d}x & =\int {u}^{1/2}\cdot (\frac{1}{5})\,\text{d}u \\  & =\frac{1}{5}\int {u}^{1/2}\,\text{d}u \\  & =\frac{1}{5}\cdot \frac{2}{3}{u}^{3/2}+C \\  & =\frac{2}{15}{u}^{3/2}+C \\  & =\frac{2}{15}(5x-50)^{3/2}+C \\  & =\frac{2}{15}\sqrt{(5x-50)^{3}}+C\end{aligned}
$$

Let's double-check that our result is correct. If we differentiate the result, then it should come out to the original integrand:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}[\frac{2}{15}\sqrt{(5x-50)^{3}}+C] & =\frac{2}{15}\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}[\sqrt{(5x-50)^{3}}]+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(C) \\  & =\frac{2}{15}\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}[(5x-50)^{3/2}]+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(C) \\  & =\frac{2}{15}\cdot \frac{3}{2}(5x-50)^{1/2}\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(5x-50)+0 \\  & =\frac{1}{5}(5x-50)^{1/2}\cdot 5 \\  & =(5x-50)^{1/2} \\  & =\sqrt{5x-50}\,✓\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :question/answer-fields ["c299197f-14a7-5515-95eb-0c4198b78e17"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "9ef53196-4f93-51cf-a11f-980d673f4584" :answer/id #uuid "9ef53196-4f93-51cf-a11f-980d673f4584" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-\frac{2}{9}\sqrt{(-9-9z)^{3}}+C" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "fb202966-738f-50e3-aa47-63ef143a8d21" :answer/id #uuid "fb202966-738f-50e3-aa47-63ef143a8d21" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-2\sqrt{-9-9z}+C" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "6b37e588-2985-50e0-b7f6-7cb598fa2168" :answer/id #uuid "6b37e588-2985-50e0-b7f6-7cb598fa2168" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-\frac{2}{9}\sqrt{-9-9z}+C" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "3bc1f79d-9230-53d0-94a1-8d0212d70804" :answer/id #uuid "3bc1f79d-9230-53d0-94a1-8d0212d70804" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "9\sqrt{-9-9z}+C" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "81cb5d78-ddc4-5567-b381-5ebc30345f71" :answer/id #uuid "81cb5d78-ddc4-5567-b381-5ebc30345f71" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "2\sqrt{(-9-9z)^{3}}+C" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "fac9a634-5a81-5ebd-9608-fc528d18a3ef" :answer-field/id #uuid "fac9a634-5a81-5ebd-9608-fc528d18a3ef" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/choices ["9ef53196-4f93-51cf-a11f-980d673f4584" "fb202966-738f-50e3-aa47-63ef143a8d21" "6b37e588-2985-50e0-b7f6-7cb598fa2168" "3bc1f79d-9230-53d0-94a1-8d0212d70804" "81cb5d78-ddc4-5567-b381-5ebc30345f71"] :answer-field/correct "6b37e588-2985-50e0-b7f6-7cb598fa2168" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "0d18d6d6-4996-55a3-8a5c-e103e6790f83" :question/id #uuid "0d18d6d6-4996-55a3-8a5c-e103e6790f83" :question/problem "Calculate $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{-9-9z}}\,\text{d}z.$" :question/worked-solution "First, we rewrite the integral as

$$
\int (-9-9z)^{-1/2}\,\text{d}z.
$$

Now, we let $u=-9-9z.$ Then differentiating with respect to $z$ gives

$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}z}=-9\,⟹\,\text{d}z=-\frac{1}{9}\text{d}u.
$$

We now write our integral in terms of $u,$ calculate the integral as normal, and write the final answer in terms of $z$ at the very end:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int (-9-9z)^{-1/2}\,\text{d}z & =\int {u}^{-1/2}\cdot (-\frac{1}{9}\text{d}u) \\  & =-\frac{1}{9}\int {u}^{-1/2}\,\text{d}u \\  & =-\frac{1}{9}\frac{1}{(1/2)}{u}^{1/2}+C \\  & =-\frac{2}{9}{u}^{1/2}+C \\  & =-\frac{2}{9}(-9-9z)^{1/2}+C \\  & =-\frac{2}{9}\sqrt{-9-9z}+C\end{aligned}
$$

Let's double-check that our result is correct. If we differentiate the result, then it should come out to the original integrand:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}z}[-\frac{2}{9}\sqrt{-9-9z}+C] & =-\frac{2}{9}\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}z}[\sqrt{-9-9z}]+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}z}(C) \\  & =-\frac{2}{9}\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}z}[(-9-9z)^{1/2}]+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}z}(C) \\  & =-\frac{2}{9}\cdot \frac{1}{2}(-9-9z)^{-1/2}\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}z}(-9-9z)+0 \\  & =-\frac{1}{9}\cdot (-9-9z)^{-1/2}\cdot (-9) \\  & =(-9-9z)^{-1/2} \\  & =\frac{1}{\sqrt{-9-9z}}\,✓\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :question/answer-fields ["fac9a634-5a81-5ebd-9608-fc528d18a3ef"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "generator" :question-generator/id #uuid "0d4336e5-daaa-56e1-9e9e-c43a2ecfaf51" :question-generator/script "generate/scratch/17592186064205.py"} [:db/add 17592186064205 :knowledge-point/question-generator "generator"] {:db/id 17592186064205 :knowledge-point/questions ["8b9ac773-a814-5857-b454-ae543e57ffe1" "0d18d6d6-4996-55a3-8a5c-e103e6790f83"]} [:db/ensure 17592186064205 :knowledge-point/validate]]
